messages.body_plain:
Dear methylKit developer

I encountered some issues during the conversion of methylDiffDB object to a methylDiff object in-memory. This conversion is necessary for the eDMR analysis.
converted<- as(myDiff_Ctrl_Cancer,"methylDiff")

Running this, I get the follow error:
Error in paste(tabixRes[[1]], collapse = "\n") : result would exceed 2^31-1 bytes

How can I solve this issue? I already tried several things, including setting Sys.setenv('R_MAX_VSIZE'=32000000000), without success. I'm working on a AWS ec2 instance.

Used the following code chunks:

...

myDiff_Ctrl_Cancer<-calculateDiffMeth(ctrl_cancer,
                                         covariates = Cov_Ctrl_Ca,
                                         overdispersion="MN",
                                         test="Chisq",
                                         adjust="SLIM", # to be chosen
                                         mc.cores=50)

converted<- as(myDiff_Ctrl_Cancer,"methylDiff")

DMR_Ctrl_Cancer=edmr(converted,
                     dist=200,
                     DMC.qvalue = 0.01,
                     DMC.methdiff = 10,
                     num.DMCs= 1,
                     num.CpGs = 3,
                     DMR.methdiff = 10,
                     plot = FALSE, main = "",
                     mode = 1, ACF = TRUE, fuzzypval = 1)

...

Thank you for your help!

Kind regards
Matthias
